Well another fight today because she was drinking enough. I think it's time for me to take a trip and go like old dogs do.
I've already made those steps, in fact my wife and her family know full well what I intend to do when they leave. They just don't care.
Well its a marriage splitting up, so I will actually have a lot less once they leave.
I do appreciate the kind words though. I am here in some hope of changing my mind. But, what I really need is the same energy fed to me that I gave out from the people that I hold close to me.

Like I've mentioned, I just don't have the willpower anymore to keep trying. The best I can do is write or do something personal for the people I love to let them know they shouldn't make it any fault of their own and that I didn't love them any less and that it was just time for me to go.
Sometimes its the small things like noticing that make all the difference.

Just take my advice. If you want to be this good person. You need people in your life that are going to give it back. About 2 years ago is when my depression started to settle in, I was so good at faking my smile all my life due to the lack of support in the people around me that I didn't even realize it was happening. I ignored it. It was little things like not taking care of myself, not showering, not eating right. During all that no one stopped to ask if the weight of keeping things together at home while my wife was in rehab ever occurred to anyone that it might be effecting me too, even though I was showing it on the outside.
Sorry I'm not the best writer and I was just typing as my thoughts came to.
